data.name: Baljah
data.gender_notes: Baljah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Baljah is derived from the Arabic language. It is a combination of two words: 'Bal' which means river, and 'Jah' which means gentle. Thus, Baljah translates to 'Gentle River'. In Islamic and spiritual traditions, water is a symbol of life and purification. The name Baljah carries the meaning “Gentle River” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Baljah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle flow of life and spiritual growth in Islam.
data.etymology: Baljah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle River.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baljah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
